FAQ

SEO in Terwillegar Towne: common questions

Straight answers to the questions Edmonton business owners ask us most.

What is a citation?

Any online mention of your business name, address and phone number, such as a directory listing.

Do directories still matter?

Accurate listings on relevant sites help consistency. Google lists low quality directory links as link spam, so we stick to relevant ones.

We moved. What should we update first?

Your Business Profile, then your website, then major listings.
